name: Master Chow Instant Noodles
ingredients_raw: NOODLES (60%): WHOLEWHEAT FLOUR, REFINED WHEAT FLOUR, RICE BRAN OIL, IODIZED SALT, WHEAT GLUTEN, THICKENER (INS412), ACIDITY REGULATORS [INS501 & INS500(1)]. FLAVOUR SAUCE POUCH (30%): WATER, SOYA SAUCE, GARLIC PASTE CHILLI PASTE, REFINED SUNFLOWER OIL, SUGAR, IODISED SALT, GARLIC POWDER GINGER POWDER, MIXED SPICES & CONDIMENTS, ACIDITY REGULATOR (INS260) AND I+G. VEGETABLE POUCH (5%): DEHYDRATED VEGETABLES (CARROT, CABBAGE AND SPRING ONION). TOPPINGS POUCH (5%): FRIED GARLIC AND ROASTED PEANUTS.
